origin: Kilns curator v0.3; 24 candidate Poly Haven links; generated CC0-independent proxies

objects.name: Threshold with Two Names
objects.action: Flip two brass plaques; their reflection swaps.
objects.inquiry: Naming versus identity: the same passage under opposed labels.

objects.name: Hospitality Hearth
objects.action: Tend the hearth; amber light reaches the garden.
objects.inquiry: Hospitality as the smallest unit of a viable future.

objects.name: The Twelve-Pane Window
objects.action: Slide color channels; split the beam into window petals.
objects.inquiry: One light, many transmissions: spectra are different from moral verdicts.

objects.name: The Stair of Previous Readers
objects.action: Open a stair drawer; a predecessor’s note appears.
objects.inquiry: Inheriting an old route is different from reciting its steps.

objects.name: The Book of Many Witnesses
objects.action: Turn a leaf; then calculate how evidence updates a prior.
objects.inquiry: Competing witnesses; Bayes updates a hypothesis without absolute certainty.

objects.name: The Unsent Letter
objects.action: Choose send, amend or keep; the envelope changes.
objects.inquiry: The absent addressee makes the ethics of interpretation concrete.

objects.name: Two Inherited Cups
objects.action: Offer either cup; both leave rings in the table.
objects.inquiry: Hospitality vs ownership; a vessel can be shared without erasing difference.

objects.name: The Story-Repaired Dragon Scale
objects.action: Rotate the relic; its label changes between history and legend.
objects.inquiry: St George and Pendragon are inherited mythic interpretations, not historical proof.

objects.name: Portrait of the Absent Reader
objects.action: Tilt the portrait; the coordinate grid speaks differently.
objects.inquiry: Same point, two coordinate vocabularies. Rotate a basis, not the vector.

objects.name: The Annotated Map
objects.action: Shift a crossing cost; watch the recommended route change.
objects.inquiry: Shortest paths depend on edge costs and constraints, not just straight lines.

objects.name: Correspondence Window
objects.action: Stamp an envelope; hear a short dispatch chime.
objects.inquiry: Messages are imperfectly transmitted; no reader owns the sender.

objects.name: The Editorial Desk
objects.action: Edit a sentence; its former wording remains visible.
objects.inquiry: Version history preserves corrected drafts rather than pretending finality.

objects.name: Wardrobe of Possible Worlds
objects.action: Open wardrobe; a miniature child world appears.
objects.inquiry: The child world is both whole and part: holarchy rather than a flat link.

objects.name: The Fireplace Reflection
objects.action: Tilt mirror; another angle of the meadow appears.
objects.inquiry: Observer position affects view; perspective is not automatically moral relativism.

objects.name: The Book's Tiny Chapel
objects.action: Grow a tree of arguments around the tiny chapel.
objects.inquiry: A recursive rule produces distinct branches; the part supports the whole.

objects.name: The Honest Exit
objects.action: Open and close the quiet door; no answer required.
objects.inquiry: An honest exit allows incompletion.

objects.name: Astronomical Orrery
objects.action: Turn the orrery wheel; different constellations phase in.
objects.inquiry: Cycles and phase can be modeled without dictating cosmic purpose.

objects.name: The Printing Press
objects.action: Print a phrase; see how it propagates through a network.
objects.inquiry: Repetition amplifies messages; false and true claims can both spread.

objects.name: Metronome of Zeal
objects.action: Wind two musical frequencies; separate their hidden pulses.
objects.inquiry: Complex sounds are sums of components; a chord can retain two notes.

objects.name: Rain-Catching Instrument
objects.action: Catch a sample; estimate the rain rate with uncertainty.
objects.inquiry: Small samples create uncertain estimates. Compare frequency and interval.

objects.name: Vitra in the Glass
objects.action: Touch a pane; light moves without announcing a verdict.
objects.inquiry: Moral weather is represented, not assigned by an AI arbiter.

objects.name: The Wren and the Crumb
objects.action: Leave crumbs; see whether a wren returns or remains free.
objects.inquiry: A bird has probabilistic choices, not an imperative to reward the player.

objects.name: The Debate in Two Chairs
objects.action: Choose to help or exploit; watch repeated outcomes.
objects.inquiry: Repeated game: cooperation, retaliation, noise, forgiveness.

objects.name: The Quiet Repairer
objects.action: Tap three nails; a cracked mullion is restored.
objects.inquiry: Matthias-like repair sustains structures quietly after rupture.
